as_told.title: Lazar: Russians kicked out as ARV tensions rose

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on a claim from Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site in the 1980s. According to Michels, Lazar's story holds that Russians were also at Area 51, a secret US Air Force test base in Nevada, as part of a kind of shared space programme. In a second telling Michels adds that the Russians were pushed out as tensions grew over ARVs, man-made craft copied from alien ones, which would mean the rival superpowers once cooperated on this.
